sources.entry: Datamosh - Datamosh your videos on macOS.

summary.one_liner: Datamosh is a macOS app for applying datamosh glitch effects to video files.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short. It says the app datamosts videos on macOS and lists supported file types as mp4 and "aiv" (as written in the README, likely a typo). It gives quick-start steps: download the repository or clone it, then either open the Xcode project and run it, or open a provided application file. It does not describe the effects, controls, or output options in detail.
use_cases: corrupt video frames for artistic effect
how_to_run: Open the Xcode project and run the application
Or open the provided application file
notable: Can be built from Xcode or launched as a prebuilt app
caveats: README is minimal; features and effect controls are not documented
Only macOS is mentioned as a platform
Supported file type list includes "aiv", which may be a typo
